definition: IndividualVariation realizes both Boolean values of each selected report. PairwiseVariation realizes every assignment to every ordered pair of distinct selected reports. In the parity-constrained subtype of old Nat→Bool×Bool worlds, p=r0, q=b0 and r=r1 satisfy r=p XOR q; pair/individual variation holds although full triple realization fails. This is possibilistic assignment variation, not probabilistic independence or causal autonomy.
note: One joint constrained interpretation retains a necessary non-tautological ternary law. The original unrestricted world space realizes every triple and contains a counterexample to that law. Neither profile is declared actual metaphysics or a source interpretation.
